tokenize_text_with_corenlp: create a CoreNLPTokenizer instance and call tokenize on text to get tokens with offsets
launch_corenlp_subprocess: launch a Stanford CoreNLP Java subprocess via pexpect with configurable annotators and memory
convert_corenlp_bracket_tokens: use the static _convert method to map CoreNLP bracket tokens like -LRB- back to parentheses
tokenize_with_pos_tagging: create a CoreNLPTokenizer with annotators including pos to get part-of-speech tags for each token
tokenize_with_lemma_and_ner: create a CoreNLPTokenizer with annotators including lemma and ner to get lemmas and named entities
